proof_scope: Proof identity correlation and history integrity (#1436): the validator independently rejects a proof whose supplied identity fields do not belong together -- a stopped frame from a different session/run than the request, a stop over source that drifted after the breakpoint request (unless explicitly re-established), a session event history whose hash chain shows deletion/reordering/substitution, or a recorded repo identity that does not match the actual checkout (--repo-root). Fields are checked only when the producer supplies them, so an un-instrumented proof is neither hardened nor broken by these layers.

claims.proves: validate_debugger_proof.py rejects (exit 1) a proofValid=true proof with: a cross-session stopped frame; post-request source drift without re-establishment; a deleted, reordered, or substituted event in a hash-chained event history; or a repo.sha/dirty recording that contradicts the real checkout under --repo-root. It accepts (exit 0) re-established drift, correlated session+source, an intact event chain, and a repo recording matching the live checkout
claims.does_not_prove: that any specific producer actually emits these identity/event/repo fields, or repo binding when --repo-root is not supplied (recorded repo fields remain claims)

cases.name: reject-cross-session-frame
cases.description: A proof whose stopped session differs from the requested session is rejected, even though the frame file matches a hit breakpoint.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-cross-session.json

command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-source-drift.json

cases.name: accept-repo-recording-matching-live-checkout
cases.description: A proof recording the REAL current HEAD sha and dirty state validates against the live checkout (generated at run time from git itself).
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; HEAD=$(git -C ../../.. rev-parse HEAD); DIRTY=$(git -C ../../.. status --porcelain); OUT=$(mktemp); python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('proofs/canonical-valid.json')); d['repo']={'sha':sys.argv[1],'dirty':bool(sys.argv[2])}; json.dump(d,open(sys.argv[3],'w'))" "$HEAD" "$DIRTY" "$OUT"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py "$OUT" --repo-root ../../.. --expect-valid

cases.name: reject-mismatched-supplied-identity-fields
cases.description: Stop-sequence, authority, request-hash, and artifact-reference mismatches (each supplied by the producer) are all rejected with named reasons.
command:
set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; python3 -c "import json; base=json.load(open('proofs/canonical-valid.json'));
import copy
x=copy.deepcopy(base); x['request']={'expectedStopSequence':3}; x['stopped']=dict(base['stopped'],stopSequence=5); json.dump(x,open('/tmp/pc-seq.json','w'))
y=copy.deepcopy(base); y['request']={'authority':'remote-ssh:box-a'}; y['stopped']=dict(base['stopped'],authority='local'); json.dump(y,open('/tmp/pc-auth.json','w'))
z=copy.deepcopy(base); z['request']={'body':{'break':'x.py:2'},'requestHash':'deadbeef'}; json.dump(z,open('/tmp/pc-hash.json','w'))
w=copy.deepcopy(base); w['artifacts']=['/nonexistent/event-log.jsonl']; json.dump(w,open('/tmp/pc-art.json','w'))"; fails=0; for f in /tmp/pc-seq.json /tmp/pc-auth.json /tmp/pc-hash.json /tmp/pc-art.json; do uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py "$f" >/dev/null 2>>/tmp/pc-all.err && { echo "UNEXPECTED-PASS $f"; fails=1; }; done; grep -c 'fails request/session/source correlation' /tmp/pc-all.err; [ $fails -eq 0 ] && echo ALL-FOUR-REJECTED
